blogs.title: DeepSeekMath: How a 7B Open-Source Model is Challenging GPT-4 in Math
blogs.description: An overview of the DeepSeekMath model, highlighting its impressive performance on competition-level math benchmarks. This post will explain how the model leverages high-quality web data and a novel reinforcement learning algorithm to approach the performance of giant proprietary models like GPT-4, proving that bigger isn't always better in the world of AI.

blogs.title: Mining the Web for Math: The Secret Behind DeepSeekMath's Training Data
blogs.description: A deep dive into the data collection pipeline used to create the DeepSeekMath Corpus. This post will explore how the team extracted 120 billion math-related tokens from Common Crawl, why training on arXiv papers didn't help as much as expected, and the surprising discovery that prior code training significantly improves a model's mathematical reasoning abilities.

blogs.title: GRPO: The Memory-Efficient Reinforcement Learning Algorithm Powering DeepSeekMath
blogs.description: An accessible explanation of Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), the new reinforcement learning algorithm introduced in the paper. This post will break down how GRPO improves upon Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) by ditching the resource-heavy critic model and using group scores to estimate baselines, making advanced AI training much more memory-efficient.

blogs.title: Unraveling the RL Puzzle: How DeepSeekMath Unifies LLM Training Methods
blogs.description: An exploration of the paper's unified paradigm for understanding various reinforcement learning and fine-tuning methods like RFT, DPO, PPO, and GRPO. This post will explain why reinforcement learning actually boosts performance in language models and discuss the future directions proposed by the researchers for achieving even more effective AI training.
